messages:
Nora (PM): heads-up: we're prepping release v1.10.0 tomorrow 11:00 PT. primary change is a model variant rollout to improve throughput. Need: internal RN draft, customer blurb, pin owner, and explicit rollback criteria. cc @here :mag:

Dev (Eng): plan: canary 7% for 20m in us-west-2, then 25% for 15m in us-east-1 before full promote. monitors: redwood.eval.quality.delta, redwood.runtime.p95, redwood.errors.rate. will wire eval checks to block promotion on quality regression.

Hannah (ML): note — our offline eval harness shows a tiny BLEU BLEED on a corner prompt set (0.6% drop). I recommend gating on eval-suite.pass_rate >= 99.0% and A/B human spot-check for 30 samples in canary.

Pri (Docs): I can draft the internal RN + short customer blurb. For customers: "v1.10.0: infra & throughput improvements; no API changes." But if quality gating fires we should say "attempted update rolled back."

Nora (PM): pin owner? also need support standby for any subtle regressions surfaced by customers.

Sam (Support): Sam and Lee can standby. We'll monitor support queue and search for uptick in "relevance"/"hallucination" tickets. If quality alert fires, we'll triage with ML immediately.

Dev (Eng): deploy-bot command below. will attach eval-block config.

```
/deploy release/v1.10.0 --canary=7% --duration=20m --region=us-west-2 --eval-block=eval-suite:99.0
```

deploy-bot: queued deploy d7e9f0. scheduled start 18:00 UTC. monitors: redwood.eval.quality.delta, redwood.runtime.p95, redwood.errors.rate. human spot-check required: @hannah to confirm 30-sample review in canary window.

Hannah (ML): I'll run the spot-check once canary starts. sharing quick checklist: sample diversity (short/long, instruction-following, code), and record any relevancy regressions.

deploy-bot: canary started at 18:00 UTC. eval-suite pass rate reporting live. human-review token issued to @Hannah.

Hannah (ML): running spot-check. preliminary picks: 30 samples selected across English, code, and few-shot prompts. will post verdict in 10-12m.

Dev (Eng): seeing eval-suite pass_rate = 99.6% at 8m, quality delta small but within threshold. p95 +3%, errors 0.1%. so far so good.

Hannah (ML): spot-check done: 2/30 samples show minor degradation in instruction-following clarity. labeling those as Tier-2 (investigate) not blocker on their own. will upload notes to the eval dashboard.

Pri (Docs): drafting internal RN: "v1.10.0: model variant to improve throughput. Canary 7% passed initial eval checks; human spot-check flagged two Tier-2 cases under investigation. No user-facing issues observed." Anyone want edits before promote?

Nora (PM): let's proceed to the 25% stage but keep the eval-block active. Dev, can you add an automated check that will fail promotion if eval-suite.pass_rate < 99.0% or if redwood.eval.quality.delta > 1.0%?

Dev (Eng): added: eval_thresholds set (pass_rate=0.99, quality_delta_pct=1.0). will start 25% stage in us-east-1 at 18:35 UTC.

```
/deploy promote d7e9f0 --canary=25% --duration=15m --region=us-east-1
```

deploy-bot: canary scaled to 25% at 18:35 UTC. continued monitoring.

Sam (Support): FYI we've routed a flagged customer thread to support triage (internal only) but no public tickets. Keeping watch.

deploy-bot: at 18:42 UTC eval-suite.pass_rate dropped to 98.4% and redwood.eval.quality.delta = 1.8% (exceeds quality_delta_pct). Promotion blocked by eval-block.

Dev (Eng): saw the fail. rolling back canary to previous model tag v1.9.9 per rollback policy. issuing abort now.

Dev (Eng): /deploy abort d7e9f0 -> aborting promotion and reverting canary traffic to v1.9.9.

deploy-bot: abort acknowledged. rollback complete at 18:45 UTC. live tag remains v1.9.9. summary: eval_pass_rate 98.4% (trigger), quality_delta 1.8% -> blocked promotion. :warning:

Hannah (ML): confirming spot-checks align with automated fail: the two Tier-2 cases reflect a pattern in long instruction-follow prompts. I'll create a focused eval slice and run differential tests to reproduce.

Pri (Docs): holding RN draft. updating internal copy to reflect attempted rollout + blocked promotion: "Attempted v1.10.0 staged rollout; blocked at 25% on automated quality checks. Rolled back to v1.9.9. Engineers performing targeted evals; no customer-facing impact observed."

Nora (PM): pin ownership? We need to record who owns pin and rationale.

Dev (Eng): Infra retains pin during staged rollouts (Dev). Rationale: this change touches model routing + runtime; prefer infra to own immediate rollbacks.

Sam (Support): support queue clear for now. we'll keep monitoring for the next 24h. If customers report regressions, we'll escalate immediately.

Hannah (ML): ETA for reproducing diff on the long-instruction slice ~6-8h. Will report back with repro and potential mitigations (tune decoding, filter, or revert model candidate).

Pri (Docs): draft RN posted to this thread for quick review: "Attempted v1.10.0 (throughput-focused model variant). Canary progressed to 25% but automated quality gates flagged regressions and blocked promotion; rollout rolled back to v1.9.9. No customer-facing impact observed. Engineers investigating."

Nora (PM): OK. Pri, please post internal announce to #eng-all and ping support and ml. We'll not send a customer-facing message since no impact. Closing thread after RN post.

Pri (Docs): posted internal RN at 19:12 UTC in #eng-all and scheduled an ops-summary to the release channel. tagging ML and Support. closing thread.

deploy-bot: log: deploy d7e9f0 aborted and rolled back at 18:45 UTC. artifacts: ci/d7e9f0/build.log, eval/d7e9f0/report.json.

Nora (PM): thanks team  pin owner confirmed, RN posted, rollback decision documented. closing thread.
